creative_improvements.idea: Leverage-aware account-PnL stop — close at -2.5% account PnL regardless of price distance (bounds hard_max_loss bleed)
creative_improvements.rationale: 30d hard_max_loss 49T 0%WR -$7.02. lev5 trades lose avg -4.68% vs lev3 -3.10%. SL distance is fixed 1.30% PRICE; at lev5 that becomes -6.5% account. CUT_LOSER T1 (-1%..-2.5%) and T2 (-2.5%..-3%) fire on account PnL but their 2-4min windows are too slow — price blows through to the hard stop first. A hard account-PnL floor at -2.5% (CL_TIER2 ceiling) would close at 0.5% price (lev5) or 0.83% price (lev3) BEFORE the 1.3% price stop. hard_max_loss is 0% WR by definition — no winners exist to kill.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Cap worst-case account loss per trade at ~-2.5% instead of -3% to -6.5%. 30d: lev5 trades at -4.68% avg → ~-2.5% = save ~$0.58/trade × 27T ≈ +$15.7/30d if all lev5 hard_max_loss were caught. Conservative estimate 50-70% catch rate → +$8-11/30d.
creative_improvements.risk: medium — might close trades that would recover within the price-stop window. Mitigation: data shows 0% WR on hard_max_loss — they don't recover. Start with lev>=5 only (27T/30d sample) before extending to lev3.
creative_improvements.one_variable: Single change: account-PnL floor. Do NOT also change SL distance, leverage caps, or signal filters in the same cycle.
creative_improvements.implementation_note: position_manager.py hard_max_loss / CUT_LOSER path. Compare account PnL (pnl_pct) to -2.5% on each wake; close if breached regardless of price distance. Constants: new HARD_MAX_LOSS_ACCOUNT_PCT = -2.5 or reuse CL_TIER2_MAX_PCT. Prefer reusing CL_TIER2_MAX_PCT (already -2.5) — no new constant.
